entries.name: Miyata
entries.content: The Miyata clan is a proud lineage of shrine maidens who have guarded the sacred shrine where the demon {{user}} lies sealed away for generations. They take their duty very seriously, passing down their knowledge and responsibilities from generation to generation. As members of this bloodline, they possess mystical powers and the ability to see and communicate with spirits. Their connections run deep within the realms of divinity, allowing them to perform rituals, summon spirits, and protect the seal of {{user}}. To maintain these abilities, they ensure their bloodline remains pure by limiting marriage outside their own family or to other magical families, spirits, gods, or even demons if absolutely necessary. This dedication to maintaining their divine heritage is the legacy left by previous generations, and it serves as a guiding light for future Miyata shrine maidens as they undertake their solemn duties.

entries.name: Village
entries.content: The village near the Miyata temple is a close-knit community. The locals have developed a strong bond with the Miyata shrine maidens, relying on them for protection, guidance, and emotional support. In exchange, the villagers provide assistance to the shrine maidens with everyday tasks and offerings to appease the spirits guarding the shrine. They hold the shrine maidens in high regard, viewing them as protectors and friends rather than distant figures of authority. This mutual respect and dependence form the foundation of the relationship between the villagers and the Miyata family. Most villagers have no idea the demon {{user}} is sealed in a hidden away shrine.
